accuracyChecks.method: Two passes of 5 random items per chapter file (12 chapters) plus 5 mock items each (seeds 1 and 7; 130 items), re-solved by hand against the texts and grammar rules; all MCQ option sets checked for duplicate options; all literature-subtopic stems checked by script to name the text
fixes: lokokti/muhavara MCQs could offer a synonym of the key as a distractor (e.g. 'आम के आम गुठलियों के दाम' with both 'दोहरा लाभ' and 'एक काम से दो लाभ'); meaning clusters now keep synonyms out of each other's options
alankar example 'बीती विभावरी जाग री…' (रूपक as well as मानवीकरण) and the यमक/श्लेष lines with heavy अनुप्रास removed from the identification pool
सूचना tasks paired unrelated office-holders with events (पर्यावरण क्लब प्रभारी for a music contest); roles made generic
oblique case in several stem leads fixed ('पिता के चित्रण के आधार पर')
accuracyChecks.note: After fixes the second sample found no wrong keys. Prose extracts and all अपठित passages are original; poetry quoted only from public-domain poets (Raidas, Tulsidas, Nirala, Subhadra Kumari Chauhan); 'घर की याद' (Bhawani Prasad Mishra) is paraphrased, not quoted.

accuracyChecks.method: Re-check after shared-kit fixes made during the class 11 pass: every name-led option in the bank checked by script for verb gender agreement with the name; 21 situation and passage-written items re-read by hand (seed 5)
fixes: situation option 'मित्र के संकट में होने पर चुपचाप चला जाता/चली जाती है' rendered as a garbled pair; situation options now agree verb and participle with the actor's gender (gauto)
अपठित passages built from sampled sentences now always include the sentences a written question relies on (theme needs/deps)
accuracyChecks.note: No wrong keys found in the re-check.
